articles.title: DeepSeek cut prices 75%. The 100x problem remains

articles.title: Ubisoft is in crisis, and a 13-year-old pirate game is part of the escape plan
articles.summary: Ubisoft has remade the best-loved game in its biggest franchise. Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced arrives 13 years after the original, and the BBC found it largely worth the wait. The Caribbean looks spectacular now.

articles.title: Most Americans now say the public should own half of the big AI companies
articles.summary: An idea that sounded radical a year ago is now a majority position. Nearly seven in ten Americans support forcing AI companies to transfer half their stock to a public sovereign wealth fund, CNBC reports. The figure comes from a Verasight survey of 1,690 US adults, conducted in June.

articles.title: OpenAI, Meta, SpaceXAI Compete for More Cost-Efficient AI Models
articles.summary: Three prominent artificial intelligence developers released new models over the past week. They all promise to be more advanced, but their biggest immediate selling point may not be what they can do but how little they charge to do it.

articles.title: The fight against AI data centers is just beginning

articles.title: The best email hosting for small businesses in 2026: Expert tested

articles.summary: Slopsquatting represents an emerging supply chain threat made possible by AI hallucinations. As developers increasingly rely on AI coding assistants, they unknowingly grant cybercriminals access to their software from day one.

articles.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
articles.summary: Apple's self-driving car program never really got off the ground, but it may have been what made the company's chips the powerful AI performers they are. Early in the development of the self-driving platform, Apple realized that it would need powerful on-device AI processing.

articles.title: Netflix is reportedly considering always-on channels and bundles, which is to say, cable
articles.summary: Netflix executives have reportedly discussed adding always-on live channels to the service. The channels would run genre-based programming around the clock, all comedies or all action films, according to a Wall Street Journal report relayed by The Verge.

articles.title: Faith Tech: Pat Gelsinger steers Gloo’s platform to lead faith-based organizations into the age of AI
articles.summary: After eight years as the chief executive of VMware Inc. and nearly four more leading Intel Corp. , Pat Gelsinger suddenly found himself retired.

articles.summary: The AI build-out has done something the fossil-fuel industry could not do for itself. It has set off the largest-ever construction boom in natural gas-fired power plants, the Associated Press reports. Aging coal plants are being kept alive past their retirement dates too.

articles.title: Zhipu’s founder says frontier AI should stay open to everyone. His own government may disagree.
articles.summary: The founder of China’s most prominent AI lab has made an unambiguous case for openness. articles.title: Meta spent a year being punished for its AI spending. Then it told investors how it would get the money back.
articles.summary: Meta has had a miserable year on the market, flat while the Nasdaq-100 climbed 18%. That changed abruptly, with the stock posting its best week since early 2024, CNBC reports. Shares rose about 6% on Friday and roughly 15% across the week.

articles.summary: For years the industry ran on one assumption, that the biggest model wins. That belief is now breaking down, CNBC reports. Companies are choosing models by task, cost, and control instead of benchmark position.

articles.title: AI bosses say demand is ‘almost unlimited’. The market is no longer taking their word for it.
